scenario.name: Passengers leaving at a stop in lane
scenario.description: After a minimal risk manoeuvre the vehicle stands in a traffic lane and passengers open the doors on the traffic side

triggers.condition: Passengers getting out at a stop in lane beside moving traffic

goals.statement: Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item can no longer drive safely

scenario.pass: The vehicle holds the minimal risk condition with hazard lights on and warns passengers of traffic on their side before they leave; the residual risk counts against the SOTIF acceptance criteria

legend.meant: Meant to do: warns before they step out
legend.meant_mark: Green ring: where the pass criterion holds the vehicle
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: Passengers leaving at a stop in lane
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about
